scope: Payment-adjacent webchat pages served under /chat/:profileId and /webchat.html

pages.description: Branded webchat widget that includes payment link confirmation flow (e.g. /chat/makan-moments)

inlineScripts.description: Server-injected profile configuration (greeting, branding, availability). Added dynamically by Express route handler in src/index.ts.
inlineScripts.justification: Required to initialize the webchat with the correct profile identity and greeting. Contains no payment card data.

inlineScripts.description: Self-contained chat IIFE: consent banner, message sending/receiving, SSE streaming, history restoration, push notifications, accessibility handlers.
inlineScripts.justification: Core chat functionality. Single inline script avoids external dependencies and reduces attack surface. No payment card data is processed in this script.
inlineScripts.protection: CSP nonce not required (same-origin inline), but script-src 'self' + nonce policy prevents injection of unauthorized scripts

serviceWorkers.description: PWA service worker for push notification support (US-916)
serviceWorkers.justification: Enables real-time push notifications for order readiness and staff replies

pages.description: Direct webchat HTML served for iframe embedding (CORS-enabled)

inlineScripts.description: Same IIFE as /chat/:profileId — consent, messaging, streaming, history
inlineScripts.justification: Core chat functionality. No payment card data processed.
inlineScripts.protection: CSP frame-ancestors restriction limits embedding origins

pages.description: Embeddable chat widget script loaded by third-party sites
pages.note: This script is served as a first-party asset. Embedding sites should add integrity and crossorigin attributes when loading it. SRI hash is generated at build time — see scripts/validate-sri.mjs.

complianceNotes.summary: All scripts on payment-adjacent pages must be inventoried with justification. Third-party scripts must carry SRI hashes. No unauthorized scripts may be introduced without inventory update.
complianceNotes.currentStatus: COMPLIANT — Zero third-party scripts on payment-adjacent pages. All functionality is delivered via inline scripts protected by CSP nonces or same-origin first-party assets.
